end.summary:
Practised checking exact answers by estimating first.
Rounded numbers and added estimates in several examples.
Kabir repeatedly treated the estimate as needing to equal the exact answer.
This mix-up remained in the final example; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised rounding, estimating, and comparing an estimate with an exact answer. Kabir used the rounding method in several examples, but continued to expect the exact answer to equal the estimate; this was not corrected by the end of the lesson. At home, ask them to estimate one sum, calculate the exact answer, and explain why the two answers can be close without being equal.
